meta.citation: Meng group linear shallow-water solver on GEBCO 2026 30" bathymetry; scenario used as training/test truth for the tsunami FNO surrogate (work in progress).
meta.notes: Sea-surface height of a 2011-Tohoku-like scenario (two-patch thrust source, Mw 8.96) from the group's linear shallow-water finite-difference solver on GEBCO 30" bathymetry (used as training/test truth for the tsunami FNO surrogate). Verified against GeoClaw 5.14 and PCOMCOT (relative L2 0.02-0.25 offshore). Caveats: Scenario source, not an inversion of the real 2011 event. Coast is a reflecting wall (h >= 10 m); no inundation. Values beyond +/-2.81 m (the 99.5th percentile) are clipped; largest amplitudes are in coastal cells.
meta.bathymetry_source: GEBCO_2026 30" (2x2 mean of 15") as used by the simulation, bilinear-resampled to 120x120

frames.decode: eta = (v-128)/127*scale_m for v in 1..255; v = 0 land
